subject.name: Economics
subject.examPattern: AS: P1 Multiple Choice 1 h, 30 questions (33%) + P2 Data Response & Essays 2 h, 60 marks (67%): 1 data response + 1 of 2 essays (×2 sections). Graded a–e.
